title: INFRA — Sprint runner daily cap + gate urgency alert

tasks.description: Add daily sprint cap enforcement to scripts/sprint-runner.ts. The constant DAILY_SPRINT_CAP is already declared (line 42). Add: (1) function getDailySprintCount() — reads logs/sprint-runner-daily.json, returns count for today (key: YYYY-MM-DD). Returns 0 if file missing or date differs. (2) function incrementDailySprintCount() — reads same file, increments count for today, writes back. (3) In main() after isInCooldown() check (line 203), add: if (getDailySprintCount() >= DAILY_SPRINT_CAP) { log('Daily sprint cap reached: ' + DAILY_SPRINT_CAP + ' sprints today. Exiting.'); sendTelegram('⚠️ Daily sprint cap reached — ' + DAILY_SPRINT_CAP + ' sprints today. Runner paused until midnight.'); return; }. (4) After setCooldown() call (line 261), add: incrementDailySprintCount(). Use only stdlib (fs, path). Surgical edit only — do not rewrite the file.
tasks.context: DAILY_SPRINT_CAP constant declared at line 42 but not enforced. Add getDailySprintCount and incrementDailySprintCount functions, enforce cap check in main(), increment after each successful sprint run.

tasks.description:
Create scripts/scs001/gate-urgency-alert.ts. Logic: (1) Read workspace/gates/phase1-5-gate.json. (2) Parse: days_remaining, posts_count (from raw.posts_count), posts_remaining (from raw.posts_remaining), pace_needed. (3) Determine urgency level: CRITICAL if days_remaining <= 5, or if pace_needed >= 3.0. WARNING if days_remaining <= 10 or pace_needed >= 2.0. OK otherwise. (4) Build Telegram message: '⚡ Gate Urgency Alert

Level: [LEVEL]
Posts: [posts_count]/30
Days left: [days_remaining]
Pace needed: [pace_needed]/day

[action_message]'. Action message: CRITICAL='🚨 POST TODAY — falling behind gate', WARNING='⚠️ Post at least [pace_needed] videos today', OK='✅ On track — keep posting'. (5) Send via TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN to OWNER_TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID. (6) Write result to logs/gate-urgency-alert.jsonl: {timestamp, urgency_level, days_remaining, posts_count, pace_needed, alert_sent}. Use only stdlib (fs, path, https). Under 100 lines.
tasks.context: Gate shows 11/30 posts, 13 days remaining. This script sends urgency alerts when posting pace is at risk. Intended for PM2 cron (daily at 08:00).
